description: Checkpoint for the Daily Code Review routine. Records the last commit on the default branch (main) that has been reviewed. The next run diffs main from this SHA forward. Update after each run.

lastRun.notes:
10 commits / 168 files (~5.3k insertions, ~2.1k deletions). The range is mostly the merged IMPLEMENTATIONS of already-tracked tickets from the 2026-09 production-readiness wave: 6fc0254 (deploy readiness/rollback/compose-nginx/env-scoped builds — ADS-1308/1311/1312/1318/1319/1322), 741c95d (unattended backups + bucket immutability — ADS-1305/1306), 1c5cc98 (a11y ratchet/axe smoke/legal routes/noindex/coverage — ADS-1326), 46f548f (ADS-1317: descoped chat attachments to lib.chat + api-route audit doc, no new gateway routes), 0fef644 (metrics gating every service — ADS-1327), 2149b1d + a0be205 (fixes for last run's ADS-1332/1333/1334), plus dep bumps (6cf253b advisories, b08bd64 vitest) and the ADS-1332/1333/1334 checkpoint commit 7974c32. Reviewed in four disjoint parallel passes (backend services + observability/scheduler/audit; gateway + pacts/contracts; frontend apps + lib.*; deploy/scripts/CI/backup). Overwhelmingly high-quality, well-tested defensive work; nearly every behaviour change ships a test. Deliberately excluded the Security routine's overlapping Sep-14 findings (ADS-1338/1339/1340/1343/1344) and the tracked ticket scopes the commits implement. Filed 2 findings:

- ADS-1345 (High/Bug): backup bucket lifecycle policy rejected by S3. apply-backup-bucket-policy.sh (741c95d, ADS-1306) transitions postgres/ and nats/ current+noncurrent versions to STANDARD_IA at 7 days; S3 PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration rejects any STANDARD_IA/ONEZONE_IA transition under 30 days and fails the WHOLE request atomically. The call runs under set -euo pipefail AFTER put-bucket-versioning, so the script aborts with versioning enabled but no lifecycle/retention applied — half-configured bucket, unbounded snapshot+noncurrent-version growth, ADS-1306 retention silently absent. Tests are --dry-run only so CI never catches it. Verified against source (sh:119-125/137-143/166-169).

- ADS-1346 (Medium/Bug): GDPR erasure retry budget consumed by JetStream publish outages. The a0be205 recovery for ADS-1332 re-stamps failed_at on a catchable publish failure but leaves retry_count at the bumped value (claim UPDATE bumps retry_count BEFORE publish, gdpr-sweep.ts:172-182; catch re-stamps failed_at only, :233-239). Each infra-caused publish failure permanently burns one retry; after GDPR_SAGA_MAX_RETRIES (3) failed ticks the saga is selectable by neither the retry pass (retry_count<max false, :146) nor the timeout pass (all services acked → missingServices empty, :100-107), so a sustained NATS outage abandons the erasure with zero delivered attempts. Alertable via gdpr_sagas{state=failed} gauge (hence Medium not High). Distinct from ADS-1332/1333/1334. Verified against source.

Systemic note: both filed findings are edge-case defects in the delivered IMPLEMENTATIONS of already-tracked production-readiness tickets (ADS-1306 backup hardening; ADS-1332 GDPR-saga fix) — the 'fix introduces a new narrow failure path' pattern, same shape as last run's ADS-1332/1333 (both regressions from the ADS-1325 audit hardening). ADS-1346 continues the GDPR-sweep retry-accounting thread specifically.

Considered but NOT filed (below the signal bar): apps/client ContactPage.tsx:18 uses a raw <a href='/terms'> for an internal route instead of react-router <Link> (full-page reload on one link of a new static contact page — trivial UX nit); non-constant-time bearer-token !== comparison in observability/metrics.ts (mirrors gateway's accepted-risk internal-metrics posture, within ADS-1327); generate-sitemap.mjs pager theoretical infinite loop (manually-run, not CI-wired). Gateway pass fully clean (46f548f added NO new gateway routes — the ADS-1317 chat-attachment work landed in lib.chat and a docs audit; the only gateway source change was the ADS-1334 CSRF Secure fix, which is correct and tested). Frontend pass clean apart from the ContactPage nit. DevEx/CI-policy and Security-routine territory left to those routines per guardrails 3 and 5.
